Tooltip_TienCoolerIceBag: Keeps food fresh inside a cooler. Melts slowly in a cooler, quickly anywhere else, and refreezes in a powered fridge or freezer.
Tooltip_TienCoolerIceBagTainted: Frozen from tainted water. Keeps food fresh inside a cooler just as well as clean ice, but melts into tainted water that should be boiled before drinking.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_Freeze: Leave it in the powered freezer for %1 hours. Every %2 units of water becomes one bag of ice, adding up across everything you set to freeze in there.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_FreezeInBags: Leave it in the powered freezer for %1 hours. Every %2 units of water becomes one bag of ice, adding up across everything you set to freeze in there. Each bag also needs an empty plastic bag or garbage bag in the same freezer.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_Freezing: %1 of the %2 units needed for a bag are set to freeze in here. Ready in about %3 hours.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_FreezingShort: Only %1 units of water are set to freeze in here, and a bag needs %2. Set more to freeze in the same fridge and they add up; until then nothing will come of it.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_NoBags: There is enough water here for a bag of ice, but nothing to freeze it in. Put an empty plastic bag or garbage bag in the same freezer.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_NoPower: This refrigerator has no power. Water only freezes in one that is running.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_Catch: From now on, water from the ice melting in this cooler runs into this container until it is full. Water that melted before, or that does not fit, is lost. Ice made from tainted water melts into tainted water, and water that runs out of a bag cannot be frozen back into it.
